` [Highlight start] Coffee does not cure a hangover [Highlight end] ` or speed up how fast your body clears alcohol, though caffeine may briefly make you feel more awake. It can also make several hangover symptoms worse.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXWpP1whoJBygWIZbNlDM2VS0KwvY9oJyHg-th8Y5GhNfyBUSfbIhWFWa2PI_nSFNH-ffQ54n56rY4l57rJtGjA3A4m_vYvXT1ywC6xDj_nHSE4f0snmiaX5dwGeQeMs4JQqa_RT6k3wjcCE_Gq-ef7_06oA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF13RUL5p-ZASjTaevQJbbEMv7QQUDWwr9C02fWK71ENJgQoko2xkvNwgKfNRK7kjQXWFyzw0IufRMAKmuT5GxQ1NxXkjEliFyCfkRjOGVRy-7Jv_oe_CIBUdHoB7qUrlSdui1FIYsvr3-NWx8NMlG2pf7kD0xuYMu7KgBiNLJ_D8lvGfYO8k)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXn3kf66XwfgnkZ7SLwQZJ7T92GeT_wMFOyjb4UBL6amBKt0wNE4bv9gw37olE_B3w--hGLMXp2_hy9qb2evSoCPIHrOSLWQQfhLNcyuSLjPfenbAVQrenBoGcm__1cKdl9MSAfhKnhlsffB-Cc8sb)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXrcFqT7MjH8v2yw_y96IZy3zFkwv7-neykaS90l3AZ-o6aT6a34P05HEff9x-vPJNTvZajXfRN8Wn9F-pUpAMYx5tcCnPzjVqKXEEq8g4oemva9TFxFshHrn9Oa1WdIouPg)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXQKn1oT2tCkKJXLZqKiXrEjaf9wPQBlRpxrjiFxIW80mWfw1fMuSXLURpyI9F-btJm5Q-54RbqmwG4GdVInxqt_R2L9JVPEdBFKpKB8kf6Ji_pQylA8QG9Rsg16EEDvJgqHHW93nCAz8MYjI1ge1UwOtEXmLudvUUuAg)

### Potential Downsides

- **Dehydration:** Coffee acts as a mild diuretic and can slow down rehydration after drinking alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXWpP1whoJBygWIZbNlDM2VS0KwvY9oJyHg-th8Y5GhNfyBUSfbIhWFWa2PI_nSFNH-ffQ54n56rY4l57rJtGjA3A4m_vYvXT1ywC6xDj_nHSE4f0snmiaX5dwGeQeMs4JQqa_RT6k3wjcCE_Gq-ef7_06oA)
- **Stomach irritation:** Coffee increases stomach acid, which can worsen nausea or an upset stomach.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF12GlcoCpvnr3ZQ53Dd2HkQU-XW9GksvUa1leOQtG8SiM0XeeWWWUWRZJtUSMCc7borMRpxh5T5nv00QDkA31-Dtka-09EXe02HJ2h2hT4lFReyTEUEbuxufGipWNLhw6OAMUrrKOibBHdsVGxjY_aZOt8CPPI8zFsWOyhDGtd8MsYwWRibTUZO2hN9ITfAjbjpYYj6nXgC34TywEtzf7a-Gh6TOOUYpf9d8QK8aHoQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXQKn1oT2tCkKJXLZqKiXrEjaf9wPQBlRpxrjiFxIW80mWfw1fMuSXLURpyI9F-btJm5Q-54RbqmwG4GdVInxqt_R2L9JVPEdBFKpKB8kf6Ji_pQylA8QG9Rsg16EEDvJgqHHW93nCAz8MYjI1ge1UwOtEXmLudvUUuAg)
- **Anxiety and jitters:** Caffeine stimulates the nervous system and can heighten hangover anxiety ("hangxiety"), rapid heart rate, or shakiness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF1_7UjHIGa_hssz3PFonLtkc-QuAQHkrunUouUmx1sHQHOq3GA0lMmGzTiRXvl7-gNK4ss6LGPuaO8HXWII33K-nUyN7kv1aVWvfWEWurhtiCE3pBsl_xC3bbREHqZL3WulKYGE0eKln9UPisYbUZDrfZk_hq2k4lvl0IH23Jb5w-KoYspSkBxkWCMeQ5)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXQKn1oT2tCkKJXLZqKiXrEjaf9wPQBlRpxrjiFxIW80mWfw1fMuSXLURpyI9F-btJm5Q-54RbqmwG4GdVInxqt_R2L9JVPEdBFKpKB8kf6Ji_pQylA8QG9Rsg16EEDvJgqHHW93nCAz8MYjI1ge1UwOtEXmLudvUUuAg)
- **Headache effects:** Changes in blood vessel constriction and blood pressure from caffeine can affect head pain differently depending on the person.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXbQaQBNSSvbUDYvBisea3GVzgmyS93zkooaqnnJs8QNwp7-pBl2MG24xTzyN7gF3fJGtbSQjpHUQOyA1KibPeD5Y0AZTkhYuqb5qY81mc2V3F45w6FNg4GYZBeNYWX_BFdt26F_Pmo54P_LWOq5cMxApzdVpkC_0IjPw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXWpP1whoJBygWIZbNlDM2VS0KwvY9oJyHg-th8Y5GhNfyBUSfbIhWFWa2PI_nSFNH-ffQ54n56rY4l57rJtGjA3A4m_vYvXT1ywC6xDj_nHSE4f0snmiaX5dwGeQeMs4JQqa_RT6k3wjcCE_Gq-ef7_06oA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF17V0bp6i88Yv2LUFWtnfzjN-7mwwl8OPn9cqJGor7G17LgZkbeECfDY_NNqDsIeIhJfNfxrl7JJgWDLIKy3-oRFbjuj2DbTctr6Q5cwDM-ZrnNuXV82ryZgxQMGnSOdC1HKzX_ymA1dXMKMoXfPLW13gAzxMQ9w-jopkj0PGZg)

### When a Small Cup Might Make Sense

- **Caffeine withdrawal:** If you drink coffee daily, skipping it completely can trigger a caffeine withdrawal headache on top of your hangover. A small cup alongside plenty of water may help prevent that.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXWpP1whoJBygWIZbNlDM2VS0KwvY9oJyHg-th8Y5GhNfyBUSfbIhWFWa2PI_nSFNH-ffQ54n56rY4l57rJtGjA3A4m_vYvXT1ywC6xDj_nHSE4f0snmiaX5dwGeQeMs4JQqa_RT6k3wjcCE_Gq-ef7_06oA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXQKn1oT2tCkKJXLZqKiXrEjaf9wPQBlRpxrjiFxIW80mWfw1fMuSXLURpyI9F-btJm5Q-54RbqmwG4GdVInxqt_R2L9JVPEdBFKpKB8kf6Ji_pQylA8QG9Rsg16EEDvJgqHHW93nCAz8MYjI1ge1UwOtEXmLudvUUuAg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXbQaQBNSSvbUDYvBisea3GVzgmyS93zkooaqnnJs8QNwp7-pBl2MG24xTzyN7gF3fJGtbSQjpHUQOyA1KibPeD5Y0AZTkhYuqb5qY81mc2V3F45w6FNg4GYZBeNYWX_BFdt26F_Pmo54P_LWOq5cMxApzdVpkC_0IjPw)

### What Helps More

- **Time and rest:** Only time allows your body to fully process alcohol and recover from disrupted sleep.
- **Fluids and electrolytes:** Sipping water or electrolyte drinks helps restore fluids.
- **Light food:** Bland carbs and gentle foods can help steady blood sugar without irritating your stomach.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXWpP1whoJBygWIZbNlDM2VS0KwvY9oJyHg-th8Y5GhNfyBUSfbIhWFWa2PI_nSFNH-ffQ54n56rY4l57rJtGjA3A4m_vYvXT1ywC6xDj_nHSE4f0snmiaX5dwGeQeMs4JQqa_RT6k3wjcCE_Gq-ef7_06oA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF12GlcoCpvnr3ZQ53Dd2HkQU-XW9GksvUa1leOQtG8SiM0XeeWWWUWRZJtUSMCc7borMRpxh5T5nv00QDkA31-Dtka-09EXe02HJ2h2hT4lFReyTEUEbuxufGipWNLhw6OAMUrrKOibBHdsVGxjY_aZOt8CPPI8zFsWOyhDGtd8MsYwWRibTUZO2hN9ITfAjbjpYYj6nXgC34TywEtzf7a-Gh6TOOUYpf9d8QK8aHoQ)

For more recovery ideas, see [Harvard Health](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF1_7UjHIGa_hssz3PFonLtkc-QuAQHkrunUouUmx1sHQHOq3GA0lMmGzTiRXvl7-gNK4ss6LGPuaO8HXWII33K-nUyN7kv1aVWvfWEWurhtiCE3pBsl_xC3bbREHqZL3WulKYGE0eKln9UPisYbUZDrfZk_hq2k4lvl0IH23Jb5w-KoYspSkBxkWCMeQ5) on hangover remedies and [Houston Methodist](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF12GlcoCpvnr3ZQ53Dd2HkQU-XW9GksvUa1leOQtG8SiM0XeeWWWUWRZJtUSMCc7borMRpxh5T5nv00QDkA31-Dtka-09EXe02HJ2h2hT4lFReyTEUEbuxufGipWNLhw6OAMUrrKOibBHdsVGxjY_aZOt8CPPI8zFsWOyhDGtd8MsYwWRibTUZO2hN9ITfAjbjpYYj6nXgC34TywEtzf7a-Gh6TOOUYpf9d8QK8aHoQ) on what to try instead.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF1_7UjHIGa_hssz3PFonLtkc-QuAQHkrunUouUmx1sHQHOq3GA0lMmGzTiRXvl7-gNK4ss6LGPuaO8HXWII33K-nUyN7kv1aVWvfWEWurhtiCE3pBsl_xC3bbREHqZL3WulKYGE0eKln9UPisYbUZDrfZk_hq2k4lvl0IH23Jb5w-KoYspSkBxkWCMeQ5)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF12GlcoCpvnr3ZQ53Dd2HkQU-XW9GksvUa1leOQtG8SiM0XeeWWWUWRZJtUSMCc7borMRpxh5T5nv00QDkA31-Dtka-09EXe02HJ2h2hT4lFReyTEUEbuxufGipWNLhw6OAMUrrKOibBHdsVGxjY_aZOt8CPPI8zFsWOyhDGtd8MsYwWRibTUZO2hN9ITfAjbjpYYj6nXgC34TywEtzf7a-Gh6TOOUYpf9d8QK8aHoQ)Are you asking for yourself right now, and if so, what **symptoms** are bothering you most and do you usually have **caffeine** every day?
